Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when my Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name has this card in its digivolution cards and moves from the breeding area to the battle area?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Lucemon] in their names move from the breeding area to the battle area, by trashing 1 card in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ and gain 1 memory.
